en: Which word means nearly the same as “big”?
Large and big mean nearly the same.

example.q_en: Which word means nearly the same as “big”?
example.why_en: Large and big mean nearly the same.

en.title: Words with similar meanings
en.teach: Many words mean nearly the same. Swapping in a better word makes writing more interesting: big → huge, said → whispered.
